screenshotHiddenWarn.message: This bookmark has a hidden tag: a screenshot records what the page shows and goes to your Diigo library (private, with the same tags). Leave it out if that shouldn't be stored.

screenshotFailed.message: The screenshot didn't work; the bookmark was saved without it.

optionHideScreenshots.message: Keep screenshots of pages out of the Swift Library: they are at their bookmark. Show hidden, or a search for screenshot, shows them.

optionScreenshotThumbs.message: A bookmark with a screenshot of its page: that as a small picture before it in the Swift Library. A click opens it.

optionPreviewThumbs.message: A bookmark without a screenshot: the preview image of its page (as social sites show a link), or its icon, as a small picture before it. Read once from the page (the site sees a request from this browser) and kept in this browser; a click opens the page.

optionNoHiddenThumbs.message: An item with a hidden tag, shown by Show hidden or a search: no picture before it (no screenshot, preview image or image of its own).

optionHideOnDiigo.message: On diigo.com too: in your library there, no bookmarks with a hidden tag and no hidden tags in the list of tags, unless you search for such a tag.

itemRecreateConfirm.message: Recreate “$TITLE$”? A new item with the same content and today’s date; the old one is deleted for good, with what only it has (highlights, its place in outliners, a share link).

itemRecreateNoCopy.message: Diigo made no new item: it saved the old one again, unchanged. Nothing was deleted.

itemNoGroups.message: You are in no Diigo group yet.

screenshotDeleteConfirm.message: Delete the screenshot of “$TITLE$” from your Diigo library? A copy goes to the trash of the Swift Library; the bookmark stays.

homeUnpinTitle.message: Takes the tag pinned away, in Diigo too

homeEditIntro.message: Move the blocks, leave out what you don't need, or add blocks of your own: what a search finds. A tag pinned puts a bookmark in Pinned.

homeResetConfirm.message: Back to the default blocks of Start? Blocks of your own go.

homeBlockSearchHint.message: As in the search box: words, -word to leave out, tag* for tags that start so (todo*), in the field chosen below.

guideMoreStart.message: Start your own: Customize Start (at the top right of Start) moves blocks, leaves them out, and adds blocks of your own, what a search finds. Give a bookmark the tag pinned and it's in Pinned, at the top.

optionTodoRandom.message: To do on Start: some of them at random, with Others for others, instead of always the oldest. Handy with many.

guideMoreTodo.message: To do: give a bookmark a tag that starts with todo (todo, todo-work…) and it shows in To do on Start, the oldest first, with Done to take the tag away.

guideTypesIntro.message: A Diigo library holds more than web pages. The Swift Library shows what kind each item is with an icon before its title, and under All in the side bar you choose one kind. The add buttons at the top right make each of them, except Kindle.

guideTypeBookmark.message: Bookmarks: web pages, saved with the bookmark form or added here, with the status of their page before the title.

guideTypeNote.message: Notes: text of your own, plain or with formatting, written and edited here and shown in the page with a click on its title. A note whose title ends in .py, .css, .html or the like is code, shown in colours. Notes are always private on Diigo.

guideTypeFile.message: Images and PDFs: uploaded here with a title, description and tags (a PDF up to 64 MB); an image shows in the page. Deleted here, their file stays in the trash, so they can be put back.

guideTypeKindle.message: Kindle: your Kindle highlights, imported on diigo.com. They can't be made or edited here; from the trash they come back by importing them again.

guideTypeAnnotated.message: Annotated: bookmarks with highlights or sticky notes on their page, made with Diigo's own browser extension. The Swift Library shows which ones have them; the highlights themselves are on diigo.com.

linksCheckChoice.message: $COUNT$ links of your library are not checked, or not lately. Check them all, also those you don't scroll to, or only until the first $FOUND$ dead ones are found.

linksHuntIntro.message: Looking for dead links among the links not checked yet, until $COUNT$ are found; each one found shows here at once.

linksHunting.message: Looking for dead links: $DONE$ checked, $DEAD$ found

linksHunted.message: $DEAD$ dead links found among $DONE$ links checked.

linksHuntedNone.message: No dead links among the $DONE$ links checked.

guideSyncText.message: Choose folders of this browser in Swift Options, and their bookmarks go to your Diigo library: once with Sync now, or kept in sync, so a new bookmark in them goes to Diigo a minute after you make it. The folder names can become tags (Recipes › Italian Food gives recipes and italian-food), and the bookmarks can be saved as private. The folders are chosen on each computer.

guideSyncOneWay.message: It goes one way, from this browser to Diigo: a bookmark that is already in Diigo stays as it is there, and one you remove from this browser stays in Diigo. Your Diigo library doesn't come into the bookmarks of the browser; for that there is the Swift Library and d in the address bar.

indexGoneToTrash.message: Index built again: $COUNT$ items are no longer on Diigo and were moved to the trash, where you can put them back for 30 days.

indexKeptShrunk.message: Diigo gave only $COUNT$ items, far fewer than the $BEFORE$ in the index, so the index is kept as it was. Try again later, or choose Build again on Swift Options if your library really is that much smaller.

indexShrinkConfirm.message: Diigo gave only $COUNT$ items, far fewer than the $BEFORE$ in the index. That usually means Diigo didn't load well. Replace the index with these $COUNT$ items anyway?

guideNews.message: New: a guide to everything the add-on does more than Diigo, such as hiding bookmarks with the tag hidden.

privacyFirefoxSync.message: In Firefox the settings only go to your other computers when Add-ons is ticked in the settings of Firefox Sync (Settings, Sync).

guideIntro.message: Swift Bookmarks for Diigo makes Diigo faster and easier to use, with your sign-in on diigo.com. It isn't made by Diigo. Here is what it adds, and where to find it.

guideAgain.message: You can open this guide again at any time: Guide in the menu at the top of the Swift pages, or in the menu of the toolbar button.

guideFormHead.message: Save a page in a second

guideFormText.message: Click the toolbar button, or right-click a page or a link. The form suggests tags: your own tags that are in the title or the web address, those of your last bookmark on the same site, and tags you often use together. A new bookmark is saved without tracking parameters, the form tells you when you saved the page before, and the toolbar button shows whether a page is in your library already.

guideHiddenHead.message: Hide bookmarks with the tag hidden

guideHiddenText.message: Give a bookmark the tag hidden and it is left out of the Swift Library, the address bar, Swift Discover and the suggestions of the form: handy for what you'd rather not see pop up when someone looks over your shoulder. To see them, search for the tag in full (hidden) or tick Show hidden above the list. Choose your own hidden tags in Swift Options; tags that only hidden bookmarks have are hidden too, so they don't give them away.

guideHiddenWarn.message: Hidden is not private: others still see a public bookmark on diigo.com, and you see it there in a browser without this add-on. Make it private too if no one else should see it.

guideLibraryHead.message: The Swift Library: your whole library at once

guideLibraryText.message: A copy of your library in this browser, so searching, sorting and filtering are instant, also with thousands of bookmarks. Search all fields or one (title, web address, tags, description…), leave out what has -word, keep a search as a filter with +, and click a tag or a site to filter on it. Start shows what you saved recently, what is waiting to be read, and what you saved on this day in years before.

guideBulkText.message: Bulk edit: tick bookmarks (also with Shift+click and Shift+arrow keys) to add or remove tags, make them private or public, read or unread, share them to an outliner, or delete them all at once.

guideTrashHead.message: A trash to change your mind

guideTrashText.message: What you delete, here or on diigo.com, goes to the trash for 30 days, images and PDFs with their file, and can be put back from there, one by one or with Bulk edit. Diigo itself has no trash.

guideLinksHead.message: Dead links, and the Wayback Machine

guideLinksText.message: Before each title is the status of its page: 200, 404, BOT, PARKED, or → when it moved. Click it to look the page up in the Wayback Machine or on archive.is, to use the latest copy or the new web address. Clean up on Start also finds duplicates, bookmarks without tags or without a title, and similar tags to merge.

guideLinksPrivacy.message: For this the add-on requests each page from its own site, from your browser. Rather not? In Swift Options, under Privacy, links are then only checked when you ask for it.

guideTagsText.message: All your tags with a box to find one, the 300 most used as a cloud, a tag renamed everywhere at once, and tags that are nearly the same (recipe and recipes) merged into one.

guideTagsCloud.message: All tags, under Tags in the side bar: every tag as a cloud, the more you use it the larger, with a box to find one. A click shows what has it.

guideTagsRename.message: Rename a tag: choose it in the side bar, then ✎ next to it. It changes on all your items at once, in Diigo too.

guideTagsSimilar.message: Similar tags, in Clean up on Start: tags with or without a hyphen, space or accent, or one the plural of the other. Choose the one to keep and Merge, or Not the same to leave them be.

guideOutlinersMore.message: Open one to write in it with the keyboard, as on Diigo: Enter for a new item, Tab to move it in, Shift+Enter for its note (all shortcuts are below). From your library adds bookmarks as links, and Share to outliner adds them from Edit or Bulk edit. Changes are on Diigo a moment later.

guideOutlinersText.message: Your outliners of Diigo are in the side bar of the Swift Library too: a tree to write in with the keyboard, with items from your library.

guideDiscoverText.message: The Hot Bookmarks of the Diigo community without what you have already, in the order For you (by your tags), with a search box and filters. Save one with a click, or leave it out with Not interested.

guideMoreAddress.message: In the address bar: type d, a space and some words to find your bookmarks.

guideMoreDiigo.message: On diigo.com: Go to Swift Library at the end of the menu at the top, and the Swift Library after you sign in. The rest of diigo.com stays as Diigo has it; in Swift Options you can let My Library and Tools open the Swift pages.

guideMoreSettings.message: Your settings go along to your other computers with the account of your browser.

guidePrivacyText.message: The add-on sends nothing to its maker. It talks to diigo.com for you, with your sign-in there, and the copy of your library stays in this browser. What else goes where, and the choices about it, are in Swift Options under Privacy.

guideDiigoTour.message: Diigo's own tour of what Diigo does: Learn more on diigo.com

privacyIntro.message: The add-on sends nothing to its maker. It talks to diigo.com for you, with your sign-in there, and the copy of your library (the index) stays in this browser. These settings are kept with the account of your browser (Firefox Sync, Google or Microsoft) when it syncs, so your other computers get them too; the folders to sync stay on this computer.

optionCheckHiddenLinks.message: Also check the links of bookmarks with a hidden tag by themselves. Off: their sites get no request from this browser for them, unless you click their ·.

optionAutoCheckLinks.message: Check each link by itself as it shows in the list. Off: a link is only checked when you ask for it, with a click on its ·, Check all links, or looking for dead links in the side bar; what was checked before still shows.

optionsGuideText.message: New here, or wondering what the add-on does more than Diigo?

linkNotCheckedTitle.message: Not checked yet: click to check this link

moveTitle.message: Save in Diigo, and remove this bookmark from the browser

syncNotWebPage.message: “$TITLE$” can't go to Diigo: it isn't a web page ($URL$).

syncFolderEmpty.message: The folder “$TITLE$” has no bookmarks of web pages to go to Diigo.

indexOptionsIntro.message: The copy of your Diigo library in this browser, which the Swift Library works from. It keeps itself up to date, so this is only for when something seems off: Update fetches what changed on Diigo, Build again reads your whole library anew.

logIntro.message: What went wrong in the add-on lately: when, where and why. The log is only kept in memory and is empty after a browser restart.

logReportText.message: Does something not work? Save the log and attach the file to a new issue on GitHub. The file contains the errors below, the version of the add-on, your browser and your settings, without your hidden tags and folders; use the filter to save only the errors that matter.

logSave.message: Save log for a bug report

logClearConfirm.message: Clear the $COUNT$ errors of the log?

logNoMatch.message: No error has that in it.

extDesc.message: Save pages and links to your Diigo library fast, with suggested tags. An unofficial alternative to Diigo's add-on.

unofficial.message: This add-on is not made by Diigo and is not an official Diigo add-on: it is an alternative to Diigo's own add-on, made for bookmarking. It uses your sign-in on diigo.com.
unofficial.description: At the bottom of the options page

donate.message: Find this add-on useful? Buy the maker a treat via PayPal
donate.description: Link to paypal.me at the bottom of the options page

browserActionOptionsTitle.message: Options of Swift Bookmarks for Diigo

cannotBookmark.message: This page can't be saved in Diigo: open the Swift Library
cannotBookmark.description: Tooltip of the grey toolbar button on pages like about: and addons.mozilla.org

commandShowForm.description: The Ctrl+Alt+D shortcut in the add-ons manager

optionsTagsIntro.message: One tag per line. They aren't suggested in the bookmark form unless you type them in full, and bookmarks with them are hidden in the Swift Library, the address bar and Swift Discover unless you search for that tag in full.

optionsTagsExample.description: Placeholder of the hidden tags field, one tag per line

optionsIntro.message: The add-on hardly changes diigo.com: what it does better is in the Swift Library and Swift Discover. On diigo.com it only adds the way there, Go to Swift Library in the menu at the top.

optionMyLibraryToSwift.message: Going to your library on diigo.com opens the Swift Library: a link to it, a bookmark, its address typed. My Library in the menu at the top of diigo.com stays Diigo's own, as does its address with ?swift=false after it

optionSignInToSwift.message: Signed in on diigo.com, the Swift Library opens instead of your library on diigo.com

toolsAddonIntro.message: The tools of Diigo for your library, with this add-on: the bookmark form with the toolbar button and Ctrl+Alt+D, the Swift Library and Swift Discover.

optionToolsToSwift.message: Tools in the menu at the top of diigo.com opens Swift Tools: without Google Play and Import kindle highlights, with this add-on. Diigo's own: Ctrl+click or a middle click

toolsToSwiftTitle.message: Opens Swift Tools. Ctrl+click: Tools on diigo.com

optionDeadLinks.message: Show in the Swift Library which links are dead (404) or whose site doesn't answer. For this the add-on requests each page from the site itself. Click the status code to look up the page in the Wayback Machine or on archive.is.

linkDeadTitle.description: Tooltip on the title of a dead bookmark in the diigo.com library

linkUnreachableTitle.message: The site doesn't answer: the domain no longer exists, the server refuses the connection or the certificate is wrong

linkArchives.message: Look up this page in the Wayback Machine or on archive.is

archiveWaybackLatest.description: In the menu of the status code before a bookmark's title

optionHideShareToOutliner.message: Hide Share to outliner: in the bookmark form and in the Swift Library (adding, Edit, Bulk edit)

optionSplitAdd.message: Five buttons at the top right instead of the + button with a menu: Bookmark, Image, PDF, Note and Outliner, so you add with one click

cleanupHead.message: Search and clean up your bookmarks

cleanupOptionsIntro.message: Find bookmarks by site, title, tag, description and more, also in a large library, and delete them at once.

cleanupSignedOut.message: Diigo didn't give your library. Sign in on diigo.com first.

cleanupPageFailed.message: Diigo didn't answer for page $PAGE$. Try again.

cleanupConfirm.message: Delete $COUNT$ bookmarks from your Diigo library? A copy of each goes to the trash of the Swift Library.

cleanupDeleted.message: Deleted $COUNT$ bookmarks, in Diigo and in the index.

cleanupFailed.message: Diigo didn't delete $COUNT$ of them: they are still in the list.

bulkPublicConfirm.message: Make $COUNT$ bookmarks public? Everyone can see them then, in your public library on Diigo.

bulkDone.message: Changed $COUNT$ bookmarks, in Diigo and in the index.

indexNone.message: No index yet. It is built by itself: the add-on goes through your library page by page, about a minute for 16,000 bookmarks.

indexOtherUser.message: The index is of $USER$. Build it again for your library.

indexStopped.message: Stopped: the index is as it was.

indexDiffers.message: Diigo says it has $TOTAL$ items, but gives $COUNT$ of them, also after the index was built again by itself. The others may only show on diigo.com.

cloudNoMatch.message: No tag has that in its name.

libraryOptionsIntro.message: Your whole Diigo library from the index in this browser: searching, sorting and the tags at once, also with thousands of bookmarks.

optionBulkExitAfter.message: Leave Bulk edit once an action is done

optionBulkClearFilters.message: After an action of Bulk edit, clear the search and the filters when nothing is left to show

optionDeleteDelay.message: Delete in the Swift Library without asking first: to the trash at once, deleted on Diigo only after 30 seconds

libraryConfirm.message: Delete “$TITLE$” from your Diigo library? A copy goes to the trash of the Swift Library.

libraryHuntNone.message: No dead links: all links of your bookmarks have been checked lately.

tagRenamePrompt.message: New name for the tag $TAG$, on all your items:

libraryImageNone.message: Diigo gave no file for this image.

libraryImageOpen.message: The image itself, in a new tab

libraryRandomIntro.message: 10 of your bookmarks at random, none with a hidden tag. Click Random at the left again for 10 others.

homeNothingOnDay.message: Nothing saved on this day in years before

libraryTrashIntro.message: Deleted with the add-on, kept in this browser. Put back adds it to Diigo again, dated today and without highlights. Gone for good after 30 days.

libraryBusyWait.message: Busy with the index or deleting: try again once that is done.

libraryForgetConfirm.message: Remove “$TITLE$” from the trash for good?

bulkForgetConfirm.message: Remove the $COUNT$ selected items from the trash for good?

libraryEmptyConfirm.message: Remove the $COUNT$ items in the trash for good?

libraryDeletingPending.message: Diigo is deleting what is in the trash · $DONE$ of $COUNT$

libraryEmptied.message: $COUNT$ items removed from the trash for good.

libraryCantRestore.message: Diigo only makes Kindle items by importing them from Kindle: this opens its import page, which gets your highlights and notes from Amazon again.

libraryDuplicatesIntro.message: Bookmarks with the same web address but for how it is written: http or https, www., a slash at the end or tracking parameters (utm_…). Those of one address are together.

libraryNoFile.message: The trash has no file of this one: it was deleted before the trash kept files, or Diigo didn't give it.

libraryNoNoteText.message: The index has no text of this note: it went to the trash before the index kept that.

libraryBadUrl.message: The URL has to start with http:// or https://.

libraryUrlNotSaved.message: Diigo didn't save the new URL. Try again, or change it on Diigo.

libraryProblem.message: Something went wrong ($ERROR$). Everything that could be shown is shown; reloading the page may help.

indexKeptEmpty.message: Diigo gave no items, so the index of $COUNT$ items is kept as it was. Try again later.

indexUnavailable.message: The index can't be kept in this browser ($ERROR$), as in a private window: it's built again each time the page opens.

shortcutFind.message: To the search box, also in Swift Discover (again: the find bar of the browser)

shortcutSaveEdit.message: Save, in Edit and in the windows to add an item

shortcutBulkSelect.message: Bulk edit: tick one more below or above

shortcutBulkEnds.message: Bulk edit: tick all of them down to the end or up to the top

shortcutBulkDelete.message: Bulk edit: delete what is ticked (in the trash: remove it for good)

shortcutOutlineNew.message: A new item below (at the start of the text: above)

shortcutOutlineNote.message: To the note of the item, and back

shortcutOutlineIndent.message: Indent the item, or outdent it

shortcutOutlineRemove.message: In an empty item: remove it

shortcutOutlineDelete.message: Delete the item with those under it (asks first)

shortcutSave.message: Save, in any field (also Alt + S)

shortcutPickTag.message: Pick a suggested tag, then Enter or Tab to add it

shortcutCloseForm.message: Close the form (or first the list of suggested tags)

syncFolderTags.message: Folder names as tags: a bookmark in Recipes › Italian Food gets the tags recipes and italian-food

syncSignedOut.message: Sign in on diigo.com: the sync goes on once you're signed in.

syncMenuHint.message: Right-click a bookmark or folder for Save to Diigo, or Move to Diigo, which removes it from this browser once it's in Diigo.

optionPageDescription.message: Without text selected on the page, the description the page gives of itself (as search engines show it) as the description

optionCleanUrls.message: A new bookmark without tracking parameters (utm_…, fbclid and the like), and at the web address the page calls its own (canonical) when that is on the same site

similarIntro.message: Tags that are nearly the same: with or without a hyphen, space or accent, or one the plural of the other. Choose the one to keep: Merge gives the bookmarks with the others that one in their place, in Diigo too.

linksAllChecked.message: All links of your library are checked lately.

linksChecking.message: Checking links: $DONE$ of $TOTAL$, $DEAD$ dead so far…

linksCheckStopped.message: Stopped after $DONE$ links: $DEAD$ dead. What is checked stays checked.

linkBusyTitle.message: The site asked to slow down (429, Too Many Requests), also after waiting: not an error. It is checked again the next time.

linkUseWayback.message: Use the latest copy in the Wayback Machine

linkWaybackLooking.message: Looking up “$TITLE$” in the Wayback Machine…

linkWaybackNoAnswer.message: The Wayback Machine didn't answer for “$TITLE$”. Try again later.

linkWaybackNone.message: The Wayback Machine has no copy of “$TITLE$”: the bookmark stays as it is.

linkWaybackUsed.message: “$TITLE$” leads to its copy in the Wayback Machine now.

homeAllReadConfirm.message: Mark all $COUNT$ as read, in Diigo too?

libraryDeadLinks.description: In the side bar of the Swift Library: the bookmarks whose page is gone (404) or whose site does not answer

optionHidePrivateFlag.message: No Private next to each private item in the list, as most are; Public next to a public one instead

setupBuildingText.message: The Swift Library goes through your Diigo library once, page by page, and keeps a copy in this browser: about a minute for 16,000 bookmarks. After that it opens at once, and only asks Diigo for what changed.

setupSignedOutText.message: The Swift Library shows your Diigo library, with the sign-in you have on diigo.com. Sign in there: this page goes on by itself.

linkIgnoreSite.message: Not dead: ignore all links of $SITE$

linkUnignoreSite.message: Count links of $SITE$ as dead again

linkIgnoredTitle.message: Found dead, but you said it is not: not in Dead links

linkGoneHomeTitle.message: This page now leads to the home page of the site: the page itself is gone

linkGoneNotFoundTitle.message: The site answers, but its page says it can't be found: the page is gone

linkParkedTitle.message: This domain is parked or for sale: the site that was there is gone

linkBlockedTitle.message: The site refused the check ($STATUS$): a bot protection, which lets a browser tab through. Open it to see if it works.

linkUseNewUrlConfirm.message: Give $COUNT$ bookmarks the web address they moved to, in Diigo too?

linkNewUrlUsed.message: $COUNT$ bookmarks have their new web address.

libraryNoTitleIntro.message: Bookmarks without a real title: none, their web address, or one such as Untitled. Fetch titles asks each page for its own title, and saves it in Diigo too.

outlinersNone.message: You have no outliners yet: Add → Outliner makes a new one.

outlinersEmpty.message: This outliner is empty: add an item, or items of your library.

outlinersItemDeleteAsk.message: Delete this item and the $COUNT$ items under it?

outlinersKeys.message: Enter: new item · Tab / Shift+Tab: in / out · Shift+Enter: its note · Alt+Shift+↑↓: move · Backspace on an empty item: delete · Ctrl+Shift+Backspace: delete the item

outlinersReadOnly.message: Shared with you to read: it can't be changed here.

outlinersNoJson.message: Diigo answered with a page instead of data (signed out, or a check of Cloudflare: open diigo.com once).

outlinersNoIndex.message: The Swift Library has no index yet: open it once to make it.
